query:
DELETE FROM event e
             WHERE e.calendar_id = $1 AND e.origin = 'synced'
               AND e.start_at < $3 AND e.end_at >= $2
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest($4::text[], $5::text[]) AS s(uid, ik)
                               WHERE s.uid = e.remote_uid AND s.ik = e.instance_key)
